title: Mamdani blasts DoorDash CEO's 'greedy algorithm,' NY slaps company with $131 million fine - Fox News
description: Zohran Mamdani announced a historic $131.5 million DoorDash settlement over alleged systematic underpayment of food delivery workers in New York City.

title: Man shot by ICE in Austin being held in detention center with bullet in his back, lawyer says - CBS News
description: Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, the 28-year-old Venezuelan national shot by an ICE officer on Sunday, said in a phone call on Monday that he's "not doing well."

title: Trump tells U.N. he could ‘annihilate’ Iran but expects a deal after the midterm elections - NBC News
description: In a speech to world leaders at the United Nations General Assembly, President Donald Trump defended the Iran conflict and said he was considering whether to “annihilate” the country and drive it “into hell.”

title: Paramount, Warner Bros. Insiders Stunned by Settlement, Readying for Layoffs - Variety
description: Insiders at Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount Skydance were surprised by the settlement with the state AGs. Now they're gearing up for layoffs.
